dct_title_s: Cloud Effective Radius (1.6 micron, PCL), Aqua / MODIS
dct_description_sm: The MODIS Cloud Effective Radius layer is a measure of cloud particle size in microns (μm). It is retrieved globally during day time for liquid and ice phases. This layer is the Cloud Effective Radius 1.6 micron PCL (partly cloudy) layer retrieval using Band 6 (1.6 μm) for pixels classified as either partly cloudy from 250 m cloud mask test or 1 km cloud edges.

The MODIS Cloud Effective Radius layers are available from both the Terra (MOD06) and Aqua (MYD06) satellites for daytime overpasses. The sensor/algorithm resolution is 1 km, imagery resolution is 1 km, and the temporal resolution is daily.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2002-07-03 and updated as new data arrive. Made from MODIS/Aqua Clouds 5-Min L2 Swath 1km and 5km (MYD06_L2, version 6.1, doi:10.5067/MODIS/MYD06_L2.061).
